verdict.rationale: n8n is a platform with a documented public API, so asking for a machine-readable spec is a fair question. However, the evidence only shows the bare title 'n8n API' (n8n-docs-16) and never mentions an OpenAPI/Swagger download. The probe of standard OpenAPI paths on the docs domain returned 404 everywhere (n8n-probe-2), so nothing in the pack shows the capability is delivered.
